technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals (RSI, supertrend, three white soldiers) conflicted by weak trend structure (below 50-day MAs, below Ichimoku cloud, low ADX) and overbought oscillators suggest caution on swing entry despite short-term momentum.

fundamental.summary: QRVO shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated earnings risk in 27 days with no fundamental catalysts evident.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (29/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (357.28), flat yield curve, rising dollar, imminent NFP event, and moderate earnings risk create a highly adverse macro environment for technology equities.

debate.key_bull_argument: RSI 9 bullish, supertrend bullish, and three white soldiers pattern with extreme market fear (29/100) contrarian signal offer short-term momentum entry near support at 96.40.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is crisis-level (VIX 357.28, rising dollar, flat yield curve, imminent NFP), price trapped below both 50-day MAs and Ichimoku cloud with overbought oscillators, zero fundamental conviction, and high earnings risk in 27 days make this a high-risk fade of a dead-cat bounce.

decision.entry_rationale: While RSI 9 and supertrend show short-term bullish momentum with price at support, the macro environment is in crisis mode (VIX 357.28, rising dollar, flat yield curve) and price remains structurally weak below both 50-day MAs and Ichimoku cloud, making this a high-risk dead-cat bounce rather than a reliable swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Imminent NFP event combined with VIX crisis regime and 27-day earnings proximity creates extreme tail risk; overbought oscillators and negative CMF/AO suggest momentum exhaustion into resistance.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding QRVO with 31 other Information Technology positions (9.9% sector concentration); adding here increases concentration risk during crisis macro without fundamental conviction.
